source_hard_conversion.scope: Faceted recovery of the pinned STL, not the original author's analytic CAD or a physical fit measurement.

limits: Nominal plating allowance adds 6.4 µm to the active layer stack; delivered film and finish thicknesses require measurement.
TPU-layer heights are above the R1 smoothed datum. The variable fitting base below it is part of the assembly and is not included in that number.
The silicone foot and side wall are parallel mechanical load paths; edge response and force calibration must be measured.
The TPU cover is 14 mm wide around a 13 mm foil. Its fitting base is widened from the verified constant-section R1 witness, inside the 15 mm source insert width.
The nominal geometry does not qualify adhesion, sealed-cavity effects, moisture, wear, dynamic bending or 20 N performance.
Static foil exits must be sealed and strain-relieved before moving-jaw tests.
Cover/base molds, complete source/peer checks and the foil-neck joins remain.
